Go to any page by its address with [app_navigate]; its path lists every page.
overview.title: The app’s pages

detail.content:
The Screener page (/screener).
Where: reached by address (/screener) or from another page.

What you can do here (tool in brackets):
On the page:
- Alerts [screener_alerts]
- Live prices [screener_live]
- Market [screener_market]
- Minimum price [screener_min_price]
- Run screen [screener_run]
- Save screen [screener_save]
- Sectors [screener_sectors]
- Sort by [screener_sort]
- Symbol [screener_symbol]
- View [screener_view]
In the "Save screen" dialog (open it with screener_save):
- Save [screener_save_confirm]: Save the screen under this name.
- Save screen [screener_save_dialog]: Naming the screen to save.
- Name [screener_save_name]: What the saved screen is called. Takes value: string.

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
detail.title: Screener (/screener)

recipes.name: Use the "Save screen" dialog
steps: Set what it asks for: Name [screener_save_name].
Read the page's state and problems in the result, and tell the user only what they confirm.
recipes.trigger: Anything done in the "Save screen" dialog on Screener
